name: retrace
description: Turn any finished AI task into a lesson your team can learn from. Type /retrace and it replays how the work was done: the moves the AI made and why, the turning points, the prompts that worked, the mistakes, and the cheaper path next time. Saved as a lesson anyone can replay later, as a walkthrough or a hands-on rebuild.

interface.longDescription: Turn any finished AI task into a lesson your team can learn from. Type /retrace and it replays how the work was done: the moves the AI made and why, the turning points, the prompts that worked, the mistakes, and the cheaper path next time. Saved as a lesson anyone can replay later, as a walkthrough or a hands-on rebuild. Secrets and personal data are removed first, and lessons stay on your machine.
